message.content: {"answers":[{"fieldId":"question_18610020008","answer":"I'm an engineering manager who builds AI systems, and Anthropic is the rare place where that work is the mission rather than a feature. I've spent the last two years scaling a real-time IoT platform from 4 pilot plants to 55+ facilities with a team of 6, and I currently build MIRA, an LLM-based matching engine in Python, FastAPI, LangChain and RAG. I've seen how much leverage a well-built internal tool gives a team — my alert engine moved plants from manual register rounds to 10-15 preemptive alerts a day. Business Technology is exactly that kind of work: partnering with users, setting direction, and shipping tools that let people do their best work.
